title: Render host .bee/verify skills from the installed binary with bee onboard --verify-only
action: Implement items 1-7 of docs/history/verify-render-standalone/plan.md (Contract). Add a --verify-only flag to bee onboard (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/mod.rs parse_args and the dispatch arm near line 672) that never calls Engine::locate. Plan with compute_verify_skill_items(repo_root) only; print the verify items (text and --json) with zero writes when --apply is absent. With --apply, write only copy_verify_skill items through the existing apply code in onboard/apply.rs and update only managed.verify_skills in .bee/onboarding.json, keeping every other key of that file unchanged; touch no bee-* skill, AGENTS block, expertise file or .bee/bin file. Absent .bee/onboarding.json is a typed refusal with zero writes. Keep every existing verify safety rule (never prune, symlink/non-dir blocked, host-edit blocked with the existing FIX text, malformed bee:only marker blocks only its own skill). In no_engine_message (mod.rs:361), when <repo>/.bee/verify/ holds at least one skill directory, add one sentence naming `bee onboard --verify-only --apply`; JSON kind stays engine_not_found. Register the flag wherever the onboard CLI schema/help lives so the CLI-shape guard and help accept it, and run the regen the build requires (bee dev regen) if the registry is generated. Red first: write a test in onboard/tests.rs that runs onboard --verify-only --apply in a temp repo with no engine visible (no packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md above it) and asserts verify-app lands in .claude/skills, .agents/skills and .opencode/skills; watch it fail before the fix. Add tests for the no-apply plan (zero writes), other onboarding.json keys unchanged after apply, absent onboarding.json refusal, and the refusal sentence. No code comments.
